target.name: Dyna Robotics
target.founder: Lindon Gao, York Yang, Jason Ma

methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $120M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.1B - $1.8B.

data.narrative:
Dyna Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $120M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company in the robotics sector, including peers at Seed through Series B stages such as Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Walden Robotics.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $240M. Peer-median analysis references three same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.6B and a range spanning $1.1B to $1.8B, directly implying $1.6B. The peer set includes Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B (Series B), Dexterity at $1.6B (Series B), and Walden Robotics at $1.1B (Seed).

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $204M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $945M. The substantial spread reflects genuine uncertainty about where Dyna sits relative to peers on execution and market traction. Stage-progression anchors conservatively; peer-median pulls upward given the quality of the comparable set. Key uncertainties center on revenue traction relative to Bedrock and Dexterity, unit economics, and the timing and terms of the next financing round, which will ultimately resolve positioning within this $204M–$1.9B range.
